name: grok-text
title: Grok Text
description: Translate a selection and improve English with the local Grok CLI
author: hello1101n

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.description: Translate the selected text and preview it before pasting

commands.name: improve-english
commands.title: Improve English
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text into clear English and paste it

preferences.name: grokPath
preferences.title: Grok CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional path to the grok binary. Leave empty to auto-detect

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Optional model id passed to grok --model

preferences.name: translateInstructions
preferences.title: Translation Instructions
preferences.description: Optional extra guidance for translation, such as tone or terms to keep
preferences.placeholder: Formal tone. Keep product names in English.

preferences.name: improveInstructions
preferences.title: English Instructions
preferences.description: Optional extra guidance for Improve English
preferences.placeholder: Keep it casual. Use British spelling.
